name: brandingSettings
description: App title, dashboard wallpaper, and ribbon/tab icon. Values are set by whichever installed package's manifest most recently declared one, not edited by hand.

title.description: Shown in place of "Featherbone" in the ribbon and browser tab

dashboardImage.description: Wallpaper behind the dashboard page (title bar, As Of line, and tiles alike): a URL, or the name of a file uploaded to this server

icon.description: Shown in place of the Featherbone quill mark in the ribbon and browser tab: a URL, or the name of a file uploaded to this server. Unlike the quill, drawn at full color rather than tinted to the theme.
